data.body:
Resumed and completed. Evidence:
- Gerrit change 2125, merged as d432e3c49b6 (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, unresolved 0). Patchset 1 failed CI only on a stale docs/cli-reference.md (the new link --force flag changed help output); regenerated via scripts/gen_cli_reference.py in patchset 2.
- Salvaged the predecessor's full implementation commit plus its uncommitted fixes to tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_caused_by_relation{,_heldout}.py (pre-existing lifecycle contracts now seed/force past the new referencing-commit check).
- Local gates green before push: make lint, make typecheck (mypy 638 files clean), check_complexity_baseline --check new=0 increased=0, and 279 targeted tests passing (test_caused_by_link_validation, write-parity oracle incl. new op=link rows, lifecycle caused_by contracts, attach_commits/transition_close/completion-gate/claim/close-gate pinning suites, facades parity).
- Grep ACs verified: single %H%x1f scan implementation, _referencing_commits delegate keeps its name, docs/ticket-model.md states the rule, SKILL.md carries the scope-of-work attribution forced-link example.
- LLM-Review advisory (non-blocking) findings noted for possible follow-up: extract_force following-token ordering hazard on link's trailing positionals, and referencing_commits() returning None on any non-zero git exit.
